brief: A closed electronics enclosure with a louvred vent so the board inside can breathe.

requirements.evidence: One Hex base · Full piece (the enclosure body) closed on every face: cover:0,0,0;full;top and cover:0,0,0;full;bottom, plus six solid end caps (cap:0,0,0;*;30/90/150/210/270/330) from capOpenFaces. check_build reports no issues and meshClash clear. Joints locked with lockJoints.

requirements.requirement: A louvred vent so the board inside can breathe
requirements.evidence: One Port louvre (port:0#0,0#0, hex-port-louvre) on the base. The configurator's port louvre is the vent part designed to vent a closed cell without letting rain in. I did not verify its exact face against the caps visually; the view tool did not render it, so the placement rests on the configurator's acceptance.

The louvre gives one vent path. I have not modelled airflow or any board inside, and only one vent was placed, so airflow is not verified. Material and heat behaviour are outside what the configurator checks.

finish.summary: Built a single-cell closed enclosure: a full hex base with top and bottom covers, six solid end caps on the side faces, and one louvre port as the vent. The configurator reports no rule issues and a clear mesh check. No board or internal components were modelled. I tried a second louvre during checking and removed it so the build has a single vent.
